export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for 'BEML LIMITED' (https://importkey.com/countries/india/beml-limited) shows 10,416 records, but the visible rows are INBOUND to BEML, e.g. exact line: '2026-02-27 | TATRA EXPORT S.R.O | BEML LIMITED | PART OF CRANKSHAFT PN 442070060974 | PRAGUE RUZYNE, CZECH REPUBLIC -> BANGALORE ACC INBLR4, India | 84831099 | BOL 7778626'. No outbound (export) B/L row with date, destination and HS code was visible on the free view. Counter check: page claims 'Total Shipments 10416 Records detected', but only 5 shipment rows were actually rendered in the free view (5 of 10,416). The 'Buyers' block lists foreign counterparties (KAMSS LTD, RICARDO UK LTD, PT. THRIVENI INDO MINING) which is consistent with BEML selling abroad, but that is a counterparty list, not a dated shipment record, so it is not counted as confirmation.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: bem lindia.in returned connection refused, bseindia.com returned only a page shell, volza/eximpedia/trademo/importgenius returned 403/JS-challenge, and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) for all queries. Therefore no domestic supply record was seen.
note: BEML Limited is a Government of India defence/mining PSU (Bengaluru HQ, 'BEML SOUDHA, 23/1, 4TH MAIN S.R NAGAR' per ImportKey). Declared HS codes 681299;840999;841330;841360 (friction material, engine parts, pumps) do not match the observed trade lines, which are 84831099 (crankshaft parts), 84148090 (compressors) and 85389000 (switchgear parts) — all on the import side. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the HS code should be corrected to the actual codes seen. Declared state 'Ladakh' is not supported by any source seen (registered address is Bengaluru, Karnataka) — flagged, not corrected, as registry data was out of scope. Revenue and export volume: null — no public figure was retrieved in this session, not estimated. Bottom line: real customs activity is proven, but only as IMPORTS; no dated export B/L and no domestic supply record were found in the sources reachable, so both statuses stay 'declared_only' rather than 'confirmed'. Further verification needs a paid trade-data view or the BEML annual report PDF.
